sources.name: 香港機舖資訊维基 (hkarcade.fandom)
sources.example_data_quote: 觀塘廣場(GAMEZONE) … 營業時間為08:00am至23:00pm。 … {{GameList/Music| maimai=Prism（$6 , 6台）| taiko=虹（$6 , 2台) | CHU=Luminous+ ($6, 2台) }}
sources.adds_over_current: For GAMEZONE Kwun Tong (map id 5985 already has chunithm/maimai_dx/taiko/other from allnet+bemanicn+ziv), wiki adds per-title cab counts and HKD prices (6 maimai / 2 taiko / 2 CHUNITHM at $6). Same pattern on other HK venue pages (Gold Star, Hollywood Game Zone, etc.). MediaWiki API allpages returns 52 titles (incl. closed/disambig).
sources.note: Fandom HTML often 403 to plain bots; MediaWiki API (zh/api.php action=parse|query) works. Structured GameList/* templates are the scrape target. Coverage is older/smaller than full HK fleet but is the classic per-cab wiki nobody had wired up (same class as the prompt's hkarcade example).

sources.name: 香港音遊地圖2 (HKRGM2)
sources.example_data_quote: places row gtGz 觀塘廣場GAMEZONE games: {"maimaidx":[6,"Prism",6],"chunithm":[2,"Luminous Plus",6],"taiko":[2,"虹",6]}; format appears [cab_count, version, price_HKD]. Sample SQLite in GitHub WhiteNightAWA/hkrgm2-backend has 29 places.
sources.adds_over_current: Cab counts + per-play prices + game versions for most open HK rhythm halls. Specific deltas vs arcades.json: 佐敦Game Zone (map 6006: only taiko+other) listed with maimaidx+taiko+wacca; 铭铿/西环 (map 6013 other-only) listed with old maimai Final; 金雞/旺角 has iidx+jubeat counts; 奇趣天地 adds jubeat. Does not invent new shops so much as fills lineup gaps and cabs[]. Frontend SPA live; backend GET https://hkrgm2-backend.vercel.app/places/all returned 504 Gateway Timeout on 2026-08-04 so live payload not re-fetched (schema verified from open-source backend + committed test.sqlite).
sources.note: WIP community map (HKRGM2 UI banner: 此網站仍然WIP). API routes also include /places/:id, ratings, comments. GitHub: WhiteNightAWA/hkrgm2 + hkrgm2-backend. Prefer this over fandom for current cab counts if API recovers; keep fandom as secondary/historical.

sources.name: Music Game Map (台灣音遊地圖)
sources.example_data_quote: 永淇樂園 (archive 2024-06-23): 營業時間 11:00～22:00; 地址 台北市中正區市民大道一段50號; machine table e.g. "2 jubeat (Ave.) 現金 直接排隊 2024-05-14"; "2 maimai (DX BUDDiES)"; "2 CHUNITHM (LUMINOUS)"; "2 SOUND VOLTEX (Valkyrie)"; also GITADORA DM, Project DIVA, GROOVE COASTER, Nostalgia, old FiNALE maimai.
sources.adds_over_current: Taiwan multi-title community inventory (Konami + SEGA + Namco), not just ALL.Net SEGA titles. For 永淇樂園 map already has a rich ZIv game list (id 9469) but empty cabs[]; MGM adds per-title counts, payment type, queue style, last-report timestamps. Covers non-ALL.Net titles (jubeat, SDVX, IIDX, etc.) that ZIv only partially has. URL pattern /game_center/{id}-{slug}; venue ids observed into the 200s-270s.
sources.note: Direct HTTP from this scout environment returns 403 Forbidden for all tested UAs. Evidence of liveness: Google snippets with venue notes, Facebook @MusicGameMap, Wayback captures through 2025-03, and id_ archive of full venue HTML with machine tables. Treat as live but anti-bot. GitHub org Music-Game-Map/backend exists but is empty (size 0). Highest-value Taiwan multi-game source if a browser/session scrape path is available.

sources.name: 太鼓之達人 - 台灣機台鼓況與店家資訊 (taikoinfotw.fandom)
sources.example_data_quote: 哈啦星球南雅店: 地址 新北市板橋區南雅東路31-5號; 營業時間 24H; 代幣 1枚10元; 太鼓之達人 新框體 價格 3枚代幣(30元) 曲數3首; 鼓況 1P良好 / 2P… (2023/10/14). 永淇樂園: 市民大道一段100號… 11:00～22:00; two 新框體 entries with per-side drum condition reports through 2025.
sources.adds_over_current: Taiwan-wide taiko presence + coin price + cab condition. Map often has taiko as a boolean from bemanicn/ziv without cab counts. 751 allpages via MediaWiki API (includes chains Tom's World, HALA, GiGO, Funbox, E7PLAY, 7-ELEVEN, etc.). Taiko-only depth; not a full multi-game lineup source.
sources.note: Fandom HTML 403 to bots; zh-tw/api.php action=query|parse works. Scope is deliberately taiko drum-condition wiki, not general rhythm map. Use to fill taiko cab counts/prices and to discover small/non-ALL.Net locations.

sources.name: maimaiDX.TW / CHUNITHM.TW 台灣機台稼動店舖一覽
sources.example_data_quote: Embedded JS: let store_data = JSON.parse('[{"id":"166","sid":"19050","name_ch":"夾到寶基隆店","name_en":"Java Catcher (Keelung)","name_net":"CATCH BUFFET (KEELUNG NIGHT MARKET)","addr_ch":"200台灣基隆市仁愛區愛四路62號","lat":"25.129297","lon":"121.744331","city_ch":"基隆",...}]'); maimai n=99, chunithm.tw n=65. Store pages expose schema.org AmusementPark geo.
sources.adds_over_current: Mostly overlaps ALL.Net Taiwan (already in map as allnet). Adds Chinese display names (name_ch), Google place ids (addr_pid), and a single easy scrape of 99 maimai / 65 CHUNITHM shops with lat/lon. Does NOT list non-SEGA games or cab counts. Companion https://chunithm.tw/ same author (IFYU). Official SEGA ALL.Net locator for TW maimai uses gm=98 (98 locations) and CHUNITHM gm=104 (61 locations) as of check.
sources.note: Fan mirror of ALL.Net, not official SEGA. Comment in HTML: 請不要盜取辛苦整理的資料. Still the cleanest structured TW SEGA shop list short of ALL.Net itself. URL pattern /store/{id}.

sources.name: X50 Music Game Station
sources.example_data_quote: 西門一店 武昌街二段134號1樓 24H: SEGA maimaiDX 3組, KONAMI SDVX Valkyire 4組, DDR Gold 1, IIDX LM 1, pop'n 1, Jubeat 1. 西門二店 康定路10號: 太鼓 2, maimaiDX 2, CHUNITHM 6, Project Diva 1, Nostalgia 1.
sources.adds_over_current: Map has multiple X50 rows (allnet maimai/chunithm only for some; ziv first-store with Konami titles) but cabs[] empty. Operator site is authoritative cab counts per branch. Small N (2 Ximen stores on page; map also has Kaohsiung allnet row).
sources.note: Single-operator official page, not a region map. Still high-signal for cab counts and rare titles (IIDX LM, Nostalgia, DDR Gold).

sources.name: 湯姆熊歡樂世界 全台門市 (Tom's World)
sources.example_data_quote: 總筆數：78. 台北金萬年店 萬華區西寧南路70號5樓; 週日至週四 11:30-22:00 週五至週六 11:00-22:00; 代幣一枚5元. Chain list covers Keelung through Taitung.
sources.adds_over_current: Address/hours/token price for ~78 family amusement branches. Does NOT list rhythm cabinets. Useful only as address authority for Tom's World rows already on ALL.Net maimai list, or to discover branches missing from allnet if any.
sources.note: Official chain locator. Rhythm games are a subset of stores; pair with maimaidx.tw/ALL.Net/MGM for which branches actually have maimai/taiko/etc.

summary: Searched zh-HK/zh-TW terms (機舖, 音遊, 機台, 稼動店舖, 音樂遊戲地圖) plus Macau (澳門 機舖/街機). Confirmed seven live sources with multi-venue detail. Strongest NEW wiring targets: (1) hkarcade.fandom GameList templates for HK cab counts/prices, (2) HKRGM2 /places/all API when not 504 for current HK lineups+cabs, (3) Music Game Map for Taiwan multi-title cab tables (live but bot-blocked here; archive+search prove structure), (4) taikoinfotw.fandom (751 pages, API-friendly) for Taiwan taiko depth. maimaidx.tw/chunithm.tw are clean fan mirrors of ALL.Net Taiwan (99/65 shops) with Chinese names. X50 operator page fills cab counts for a major Taipei chain. Tom's World is address-only for 78 mall arcades. Macau: no dedicated multi-venue music-game wiki/map found; map already has 9 Macau venues mostly from allnet+ziv+bemanicn (e.g. Yurakucho). Region map counts at check: Taiwan 227, Hong Kong 34, Macau 9 (270 total; 8 other-only). Compared three examples against data/arcades.json: GAMEZONE Kwun Tong (cabs missing), 佐敦Game Zone / 铭铿 other-only (HKRGM2 has games), 永淇樂園 (MGM adds cab counts for titles map already knows).
dead_ends: BemaniCN map.bemanicn.com already in pipeline (not a new find). ALL.Net location.am-all.net Taiwan (gm=98 maimai ~98 locs, gm=104 CHUNITHM ~61) already used as allnet source. ZIv already used. MusicGameMapHK Facebook page is promotional/history, not a structured multi-venue database. Rhythm Game Map mobile app (com.seielika.rhythm_game_map) claims multi-country machine maps but has no public web/API (Facebook posts allege it mirrored MGM data). mgm.wind-chime.info live origin 403 to all tested clients (still indexed). HKRGM2 backend /places/all 504 on 2026-08-04. GitHub Music-Game-Map/backend empty. Macau: Yurakucho Facebook is single-shop; no Macau-wide cab wiki found. Google Maps/Yelp/TripAdvisor intentionally not treated as sources. One-off travel blogs (e.g. old orochinagi HK guide) skipped.
